answer: Agents register in opal, a consensus contract, using TPM/SGX enclave quotes proving unique hardware identity; hollow is the state-tree root binding each quote to one agent, while velvet is a verification circuit checking quote freshness and nonduplication. An attacker must provision distinct physical silicon and forge enclave measurements; registration bonds use a quadratic O(N^2) curve, while equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral, making Sybil identities superlinear in capital.
